Subject: Beacon Headlamps Are Back — 210 Units Available
Preview: 400 lumens, 40 hours of runtime, 95 grams. Ready when you are.
Body: The Northbay Beacon Headlamp (NB-LMP-05) is restocked — 210 units available.

You're planning a pre-dawn start, a long push through the dark, or a multi-night trip where weight and battery life actually matter. Here's what the Beacon brings to that:

• 400 lumens of output — enough for trail reading, camp tasks, and moving confidently in the dark.
• Up to 40 hours of runtime so you're not rationing light on night two or three.
• USB-C rechargeable — one cable type, no proprietary charger to track down.
• 95 grams on your head. You'll forget it's there.

This isn't a Search and Rescue spotlight or a caving rig. It's a capable, lightweight headlamp built for backpacking and general trail use.

Stock is limited to what's on hand.
